handoffCopy.createPageHint: You are creating an evaluation as part of the First evaluation lab. Run full automation or create manually — your evaluation will be highlighted on the dashboard when you return.
handoffCopy.dashboardBanner: Your evaluation from the First evaluation lab is highlighted below. Open Compare to see scored answers, or return to the lab when you are done.

steps.title: Open the create page
steps.body: Start by opening AiEval's create page. You can leave title and prompt empty and use Run full automation, or fill them in yourself.

steps.title: Run full automation
steps.body: On the create page, click Run full automation. AiEval will generate answers, score them against the default rubric, and draft an improved response. This may take a few minutes.

steps.title: Find your evaluation on the dashboard
steps.body: When automation finishes, open the dashboard. Your lab evaluation is highlighted so you can spot it among other evaluations.

steps.title: Compare the answers
steps.body: Open Compare on your evaluation to read each model answer and see how the rubric scores line up. Notice which answer won and why.
